# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster at Brierley school  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)</sub>

## Appearance

He twirls his mustache.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

He possesses a mocking, sarcastic tone toward his students that they detest. He can be overbearing, harsh, and unfair in his discipline, though he is also capable of showing emotion, such as tearing up during his parting address. He is easily distracted from his teaching duties by romantic interests.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Traits

- Sarcastic  <sub>[v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065)</sub>
- Strict disciplinarian  <sub>[v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089)</sub>
- Romantic  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching  <sub>[v1 c15 P12](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0012)</sub>
- Reciting dramatics  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>

## Goals

- To woo Sukey Pullen  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>

## History

Mr. Pidgeon served as the schoolmaster at Brierley school. During his tenure, he spent much of his time giving extra help to older students preparing for entrance exams, particularly Sukey Pullen, with whom he engaged in flirtatious behavior. His neglect of other students, poor discipline, and unfair punishments drew criticism from locals and students alike. On one occasion, he made Nell Harcourt stand on the dais for breaking her slate over Hugh Carrow's head after Hugh teased her about her hair. On another day, he punished Nell for arriving late by making her sit next to Hugh Carrow. At the Debating Club concert, he delivered an emotional recitation of Mark Antony's address over Caesar while looking at Sukey Pullen. At the end of the school year, he gave a moving farewell speech to his students before departing Brierley school.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c21 P1](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_
